title: Spring force at rest
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the spring force at rest as F = (3/8)mg.

title: Mass of ring A
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the mass of ring A as M = (9/64)m.

title: Total work done
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total work done as W = (31/30)mgL.

title: Force equilibrium on B
description: Important: Applies vertical and horizontal force equilibrium to ball B at rest to relate tensions and weight.

title: Centripetal force on B
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law for circular motion to ball B at the final angular speed.

title: Centripetal force on A
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law for circular motion to ring A, relating spring force, mass, and radius.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Correctly applies the work-energy theorem, summing changes in kinetic and potential energy for both bodies.

title: Geometry and kinematics
description: Optional: Correctly determines the radial positions and height change from the given string lengths and angles.

title: Sign error in spring force
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly states the spring force direction or sign in the equilibrium equations.

title: Unit or factor omission
description: Pitfall: Omits the gravitational acceleration g or trigonometric factors in final expressions.
